01 / The challenge

The challenge for mobile bars & horseboxes.

Mobile bars trade on looks. Whether it is a converted horsebox, a vintage van or a box truck, the vehicle is part of the experience at weddings, festivals and events, and it ends up in a lot of photos.

01

Photographed constantly

Your bar will appear in wedding and festival photos. It has to look good from every angle.

02

Converted vehicles

Horseboxes and vintage vans have curves, hatches and unusual panels.

03

Different events

A wedding and a beer festival may need a different feel.

02 / What to include

What your van must say.

  • Bar name and logo
  • What you serve: cocktails, prosecco, craft beer
  • Social handles for event photos
  • Booking website

Before you book

Good to know.

Can you wrap a converted horsebox?

Yes. Send photos and measurements, including hatches and curved panels.

Can we change the design for different events?

You can add removable panels for seasonal or event-specific messages.

How long does a full wrap last?

With good care, a quality cast wrap lasts several years. We will give you aftercare advice.
